chunks: We have given you a clear victory.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the 'clear victory' (Fathun Mubin) in Surah Al-Fath?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this 'manifest victory' is interpreted not merely as a political treaty but as the spiritual and political elevation of the Prophet and his Ahl al-Bayt, foreshadowing the ultimate triumph of truth. The verse establishes the Hudaybiyyah peace accord as a strategic divine decree that paved the way for the conquest of Mecca, demonstrating how apparent setbacks can conceal profound divine success.
